groups.why_chosen: A small worked hypergraph (3 queries, 5 compute blocks, 3 KV, 3 outputs) that teaches the paper's vertex/weight/hyperedge notation on one concrete example before it is used at scale.
groups.what_to_learn: Beneath each vertex circle print its [compute, data] weight tuple; group each hyperedge's members with a translucent hatch-coloured region instead of drawn lines — but overlapping hyperedges blend into a hard-to-read plaid where several share a block.
